paywall.title: Chatbot widgets are not in your plan
paywall.body: Your plan doesn't include chatbot widgets. Upgrade to unlock this feature.

list.tipBody: Drop a one-line snippet onto any site to launch a floating chat bubble. Each widget can be powered by a smart agent, route to WhatsApp, or both — visitor conversations land in your team inbox.
list.trainBody: Build a smart agent + add knowledge in <link>AI Training</link>, then attach it here so your widget answers in your voice.
list.title: Chatbot
list.intro: Embed a floating chat bubble on any page. Smart-agent replies in-browser, hands off to Unified Inbox when needed.
list.loadError: The widgets could not be loaded.
list.emptyBody: Build your first chat widget — it'll live as a floating bubble on the page you embed it on.
list.noMatch: No widget on this page matches your search.
list.copied: Snippet copied — paste before {tag} on your site.
list.duplicateFailed: The widget could not be duplicated.
list.rotated: Token rotated — copy the new snippet.
list.rotateBody: The current snippet on your site will stop working immediately. You'll need to copy and paste the new snippet.
list.deleteBody: The embed snippet on your site will stop working immediately. Past conversations stay in your team inbox.

customize.loadError: The widget could not be loaded. Refresh to try again.
customize.untouched: You are still using the default look. Review it, then save to unlock Deploy and Publish.
customize.saveFailed: Could not save the widget. Try again.

launcher.title: Closed launcher
launcher.hint: What visitors see before they open the chat: a callout, an animation and an unread dot.
launcher.calloutOn: Show a callout next to the launcher
launcher.popupTextRequired: Add the callout text, or turn the callout off.

chat.title: Chat window
chat.hint: How the window looks and behaves. Its colours are set above.
chat.icons: Round icon in front of each reply button
chat.suggestionsHint: Up to 4 short lines. They disappear once the visitor writes.
chat.actions: Copy and thumbs icons under each bot line
chat.voice: Voice conversation (uses the browser's speech tools)

preview.title: Live preview
preview.error: The preview could not be loaded. Refresh to try again.
preview.hint: This is the real chat window with your unsaved settings. The conversation and buttons are samples.

brand.title: Brand pictures and extras

avatar.label: Chatbot avatar
avatar.hint: Shown beside each message the bot sends.

background.label: Chat background
background.hint: A picture behind the conversation. Optional.

brand.autoOpenHint: 0 keeps the chat closed until the visitor opens it. It opens once per visit.
brand.sound: Play a soft sound for new bot lines
brand.speak: Read the bot’s lines aloud (browser voice)

devices.title: Show the widget on
devices.hint: A phone is up to 768 px wide, a tablet up to 1024 px.

brand.pip: Offer a floating chat window when the visitor switches tabs
brand.pipHint: Like a video call, the chat can float over other tabs and apps (Chrome and Edge). The visitor is asked once to allow notifications, and the browser decides when a window may open.

domains.label: Only show the chat on these websites
domains.hint: Visitors on any other site get no chat. Enter the site address, for example example.com. A site’s subdomains are not included unless you add them.

leads.look: Logo, pictures, colours and how the header looks.
leads.voice: The name, the welcome line and the send button.
leads.window: Size, typeface, reply buttons and helpers.
leads.launcher: What visitors see before they open the chat.
leads.launch: Where the widget opens from and how to put it on your site.
leads.chat: Notification cards, quick menu, banner and quick replies.
leads.behave: When the chat opens, how it sounds and who sees it.

customize.footer: Changes show in the preview as you make them.

conversation.title: Conversation tools

fields.title: Title
fields.urlHint: A web page, tel: or mailto: address. Leave empty for no button.
fields.menuUrlHint: Leave empty to send the title as a message the bot answers.
fields.videoHint: Paste a YouTube or Vimeo link, or its embed code.

conversation.noSteps: This bot has no steps yet. Add some in the Build tab and save.
conversation.replyAsMessage: Send the line as a message

customize.launchNote: The embed code to paste on your site is on the Deploy tab.

deploy.locked: Save the Customize tab first. Your embed code appears here once the widget exists.
deploy.lockedWhatsapp: Save the Customize tab first. Your website button and WhatsApp link appear here once it exists.
deploy.title: Deploy
deploy.lead: Put your chat window on your website. The bot goes live when you publish it.
deploy.leadWhatsapp: Put your WhatsApp button on your website, or share the direct link anywhere. The bot answers on its WhatsApp number once it is published.
deploy.notPublished: This bot is not published yet, so visitors will not get answers. Publish it from the Build tab.
deploy.notPublishedWhatsapp: This bot is not published yet, so it will not answer on WhatsApp. Publish it from the Build tab.
deploy.embedBody: Paste this just before the closing body tag on every page where it should appear.
deploy.clipboardBlocked: Your browser blocked copying. Select the text and copy it by hand.
deploy.linkBody: Opens a WhatsApp chat with the bot's number and the message you set. Use it in emails, social bios, QR codes and ads.
deploy.qrBody: Print it or show it on a screen. Scanning it opens a WhatsApp chat with your bot.
deploy.localNote: This code points to an address on this computer (localhost), so it only works on pages opened here. On a live website, use your deployed address instead.

whatsapp.loadError: The button could not be loaded. Refresh to try again.
whatsapp.untouched: Your WhatsApp button is not set up yet. It starts from your bot's number and keyword. Review it, then save to unlock Deploy and Publish.
whatsapp.saveFailed: Could not save the button. Try again.
whatsapp.fromBot: The button opens WhatsApp on {number}, the number this bot runs on. Change the number on the Trigger in the Build tab.
whatsapp.noNumber: This bot has no WhatsApp number yet. Choose one on the Trigger in the Build tab, then come back to save the button.

builder.notFoundBody: This widget does not exist in your workspace.
builder.loadError: The widget could not be loaded.
builder.saveFailed: Save failed — check the highlighted step.
builder.clipboardBlocked: Clipboard blocked — select the snippet manually.

problem.name: Name your widget.
problem.assistant: Link a smart agent — or switch the engine to WhatsApp deep-link.
problem.whatsapp: Add a full WhatsApp number — country code and digits.
problem.launcherColour: Launcher fill must be a hex colour (e.g. #075E54).
problem.headerTitle: Give the chat window a title.
problem.bgImage: Add a background image URL or switch to solid colour.

setup.title: Widget setup
setup.name: Internal name
setup.nameHint: For your team. Visitors don't see this label.
setup.positionHint: Where the round chat bubble floats on your site.

ai.title: Smart agent
ai.body: Trained AI answers right in the browser.

whatsapp.title: WhatsApp deep-link
whatsapp.body: Send the visitor into the WhatsApp app to chat.

both.title: Smart + WhatsApp
both.body: Visitor picks — chat here or open WhatsApp.

setup.whatsappHint: Pick the country flag — the dial code is added automatically.
setup.prefilledPlaceholder: Hi, I'd like to know more about pricing.
setup.prefilledHint: The visitor lands in WhatsApp with this message already typed.

look.title: Launcher & window styling
look.headerTintHint: Top strip of the chat window.
look.iconHint: PNG / SVG · 80×80 px recommended · transparent background.

voice.title: Opening message & chat surface
voice.openingPlaceholder: Hi! How can we help today?
voice.openingHint: First bubble shown when the chat opens.
voice.bubbleFillHint: Colour of bubbles from your side.
voice.autoOpenHint: Opens the chat ~1.2 s after the page loads.
voice.intakeHint: Pre-chat fields shown before the chat begins. Skip everything for anonymous chat.

launch.title: Send-button & embed snippet
launch.label: Send-button label
launch.labelHint: Avoid "Submit". Try "Send message" or "Ask the team".
launch.ready: Ready. Paste this just before {tag} on the page you want the widget on.

whatsappBuilder.title: WhatsApp Widget
whatsappBuilder.nameHint: Only you see this name. It is also the business name shown in the messenger.
whatsappBuilder.saved: Changes saved. Your widget is live.

1.title: Style your WhatsApp chat button
1.subtitle: Pick a beautiful chat button designs what suits your website best
1.animationHint: Draws the eye to the button while the chat is closed.

2.title: Design your messenger
2.subtitle: Pick a beautiful image for your messenger
2.url: Or use your own image address
2.urlHint: Paste the address of a square image (https://...). Uploading a file is not available yet.
2.botNameHint: Shown in the header of the chat window. Leave it empty to use your bot's name.

3.title: Set your welcome message
3.subtitle: Welcome your customers
3.greetingHint: Say Hi to your customers when they open messenger
3.introHint: Introduce your business and tell customers how you can help
3.subHeaderHint: The line under the name, for example how quickly you reply.
3.ctaHint: The text on the button that opens WhatsApp.
3.prefilledHint: What a tap on the button sends. It starts as your bot's keyword, so the bot starts.

4.title: Set your Chat Button position
4.subtitle: Adjust your button position on computers and mobile

5.title: Configure your WhatsApp number
5.subtitle: Connect the WhatsApp number to the messenger
5.numberHint: Messenger will send your customers to this WhatsApp number
5.prefilledHint: This will be first default message text

6.title: Show a popup message
6.subtitle: A small bubble that invites visitors to chat
6.visibilityHint: Show the popup next to the button until a visitor dismisses it.
6.textHint: A short invitation, for example: Hi! May I assist you?
6.imageHint: An image address, or upload a picture below.

install.title: Install on your website
install.body: Paste this tag just before the closing body tag of every page that should show the widget.

problem.name: Name your widget.
problem.avatar: Use a built-in image or an http(s) image address.
problem.spacing: Spacing must be a whole number of pixels from 0 to 500.
problem.whatsapp: Add a full WhatsApp number: country code and digits.
problem.prefilled: Add the message a tap on the button sends.
problem.popupText: Add the popup text, or switch the popup off.
problem.popupImage: Use a built-in image or an http(s) image address.

preview.title: Live preview
preview.frameTitle: Live preview of your WhatsApp widget
preview.hint: Collapse the panel with the round button, open it again from the launcher, and try Start Conversation.

upload.hint: SVG, PNG, JPG, WebP or GIF, up to 1 MB.
upload.failed: The image could not be uploaded. Try again.
upload.tooLarge: The image is larger than 1 MB.
